explicit_validation.explanation: Paper explicitly compares GPT-3.5 win rate evaluation against human preferences on 100 samples, grouping by AlignScore thresholds and reporting preference percentages

validation_results.summary_finding: AlignScore aligns with human judgment to some extent, with MPO achieving 51% overall win rate against human preference optimized models

criteria_mapping.notes: LLM uses AlignScore metric while humans provide direct preference judgments, both evaluating similar aspects of summary quality
